cohort: 17,331 nulliparous women with a term, singleton, vertex fetus who were exposed to oxytocin during labor
finding: Exposure to greater than 11,400 mU of oxytocin during labor was associated with a 1.6 times increased odds of primary cesarean birth compared to lower exposures.
mod_finding: Exposure to greater than 11,400 milliunits of oxytocin during labor was associated with an increased odds of primary cesarean birth in nulliparous women with term, singleton, vertex fetuses.
